description: Use for "do A when B does C": a programmable escrow. The payer locks ETH, USDG or any ERC-20; the payee is paid when ALL conditions are true (time passed, a named agent/arbiter attested, an onchain read like a token balance or price is above/below a value). If they are not met by the expiry, anyone can refund the payer. Returns the approve and createAgreement transactions. No account, no signature.

asset.description: "eth", "usdg" or a token address. Default eth.

conditions.description: 1 to 8 conditions, all must be true. Each: {type:"time_after", afterHours|at} | {type:"attest", by:"0xWallet"} | {type:"token_balance_gte", token, holder, min} | {type:"call_gte"|"call_lte", target, data, value} | {type:"deal_settled", dealId} | {type:"unless", by, afterHours} (pays unless this wallet objects) | {type:"quorum", by:[wallets], k}. A time_after or unless must end before expiryHours.

expiryHours.description: Hours until anyone can refund the payer if the conditions are not met. Default 72.

payee.description: Wallet that is paid when every condition is true.

payer.description: Wallet that locks the funds. It sends the approve and createAgreement transactions.

terms.description: The agreement in plain words (optional). Its hash is stored onchain.

name: bull_agreement_create
